encoder: legalese-sonnet-5.5: one Sonnet 5.5 agent working alone, solo, no sub-agents
display_name: SG § 30c and SAZV § 1 with its Anlage, time off for soldiers' overtime: a law layer, a seat for the soldier, and the Art. 80(1) sentence 3 citation test
seat: a soldier serving within the remit of the Federal Ministry of Defence, asking whether § 30c(1) to (3) of the Soldiers Act apply to them, how many hours of time off they must be given for ordered overtime, and by when.
edition: SG §§ 30c, 30d, 93; SAZV § 1, Anlage, Eingangsformel; Grundgesetz Art. 80, as printed on gesetze-im-internet.de on 2026-11-02; BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 and BGBl. 2022 I Nr. 34 (gazette text and PDF); excerpts of BVerwG 3 B 51.18, BVerwG 2 C 31.15, OVG NRW 3 A 1217/14 and BVerfG 2 BvF 3/90 (../../registers/source-bundle/).
not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the text. The consolidated texts are the site's reading versions; the 2022 and 2025 annexes were read from the gazette PDFs. The tests' expected values were written by the encoder from the text, not by an independent author.

check_sh_output: target: main. Each module is run with your l4 and with the main build below; the main columns must match.
module                                    errors satisfied  failed  refused  expected | errors satisfied  failed  refused  main
(a failed assertion is also an error; any other error, or any refused assertion, makes the run red)

(target main: every module has the same four counts on the main build. That rules out a module main rejects and a difference an assertion shows; it does not see a different TRACE outcome, or any difference no assertion exercises)

scope.intent: SG § 30c(2), (4), (6); SG § 93(2) no. 7; SAZV § 1 and Anlage in its 2025 and 2022 forms; the preambles of the 2015 SAZV and the 2022 and 2025 amending regulations; Grundgesetz Art. 80(1) sentence 3 as the citation test. Not the rest of the Soldiers Act or the Regulation.
